name: headings
prompt: Implement thematic breaks (`***`, `---`, `___`), ATX headings (`# Title`) and setext headings (underlined with `===` or `---`), as specified in CommonMark 0.31.2, sections 4.1-4.3: https://spec.commonmark.org/0.31.2/#thematic-breaks . Render them as `<hr />`, `<h1>`...`<h6>`.

name: code-blocks
prompt: Implement indented code blocks and fenced code blocks (``` and ~~~ fences, info strings rendered as `class="language-..."`), as specified in CommonMark 0.31.2, sections 4.4-4.5 (https://spec.commonmark.org/0.31.2/#indented-code-blocks), including the tab handling of section 2.2 (Tabs).

name: html-blocks
prompt: Implement HTML blocks (the seven kinds of start and end conditions), as specified in CommonMark 0.31.2, section 4.6: https://spec.commonmark.org/0.31.2/#html-blocks . HTML blocks are passed through to the output unchanged.

name: link-refs
prompt: Implement link reference definitions (`[label]: /url "title"`), as specified in CommonMark 0.31.2, section 4.7: https://spec.commonmark.org/0.31.2/#link-reference-definitions . Definitions are recognised at the start of paragraphs, removed from the output, and recorded (with case-insensitive, whitespace-normalised labels; the first definition of a label wins) so that reference links can use them.

name: blockquotes
prompt: Implement block quotes (`> quoted`), including lazy continuation lines, as specified in CommonMark 0.31.2, section 5.1: https://spec.commonmark.org/0.31.2/#block-quotes . Render them as `<blockquote>`.

name: lists
prompt:
Implement list items and lists (bullet lists with `-`, `+`, `*`; ordered lists with `1.` or `1)` and start numbers; tight and loose lists), as specified in CommonMark 0.31.2, sections 5.2-5.3: https://spec.commonmark.org/0.31.2/#list-items . Render `
    `/`
      `/`
    1. `; paragraphs in tight lists are rendered without `

      ` tags.

name: escapes-entities
prompt: Implement backslash escapes and entity and numeric character references (`&`, `#`, `"`, all HTML5 named entities), as specified in CommonMark 0.31.2, sections 2.4 and 2.5: https://spec.commonmark.org/0.31.2/#backslash-escapes . Note where escapes and entities are recognised (also in link destinations, titles and code fence info strings) and where they are not (code spans, code blocks, autolinks, raw HTML).

name: code-spans
prompt: Implement code spans (`` `code` ``, backtick strings of any length), as specified in CommonMark 0.31.2, section 6.1: https://spec.commonmark.org/0.31.2/#code-spans . Render them as `<code>`.

name: emphasis
prompt: Implement emphasis and strong emphasis with `*` and `_` (left- and right-flanking delimiter runs, the rule of 3, and the delimiter-stack algorithm of the spec appendix "An algorithm for parsing nested emphasis and links"), as specified in CommonMark 0.31.2, section 6.2: https://spec.commonmark.org/0.31.2/#emphasis-and-strong-emphasis . Render `<em>` and `<strong>`.

name: links
prompt: Implement links: inline links `[text](/url "title")` and reference links (full `[text][label]`, collapsed `[label][]` and shortcut `[label]`), as specified in CommonMark 0.31.2, section 6.3: https://spec.commonmark.org/0.31.2/#links , following the spec appendix "An algorithm for parsing nested emphasis and links". Render `<a href="..." title="...">`; link destinations are percent-encoded as in the spec examples.

name: images-autolinks
prompt: Implement images `![alt](/src "title")` (inline and reference forms, alt text is the plain text of the description) and autolinks (``, ``), as specified in CommonMark 0.31.2, sections 6.4-6.5: https://spec.commonmark.org/0.31.2/#images . Render `` and ``.

name: raw-html-breaks
prompt:
Implement inline raw HTML (open and closing tags, comments, processing instructions, declarations, CDATA) and hard line breaks (two or more trailing spaces, or a backslash, before a line ending), as specified in CommonMark 0.31.2, sections 6.6-6.7: https://spec.commonmark.org/0.31.2/#raw-html . Render hard line breaks as `
` followed by a newline.
